column2: A Strange Child

There is something wrong with little [From.GetFirstName]. The dogs will not go near the cradle, the milk sours in the nurse's jug, and the candles in the nursery burn with a greenish flame. Last night the nurse swore she heard the babe laughing in a voice that was not a child's, and this morning she would not come back.\n\nPerhaps it is nothing. Perhaps.
I will pray and fast. [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName] protect my son.
The Dark Gods have looked upon my son!
I will pray and fast. [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName] protect my child.
The Dark Gods have given me this child!
Send for my [Root.GetLordSpiritualName].
Your [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] will examine the child

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has asked me to examine [FromFrom.GetFirstName]. I have seen the signs before, in the old books of the temple: the cold in the room, the soured milk, the eyes that follow one about. Either the child is merely sickly and strange, or the Ruinous Powers have their hand upon it - and if so, someone opened the door for them.
It is nothing. Tell them not to worry.
The mother has been consorting with daemons!
The child's mother is a witch!
[From.GetFirstName] will be accused of witchcraft
[From.GetFirstName] will be told that the child's mother is a witch
My [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] has examined [From.GetFirstName] and found nothing amiss: a sickly child, a superstitious nurse and a draughty nursery. Prayers and a good wet nurse will see to it.
What a relief!

My [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] has examined [From.GetFirstName], and now [FromFrom.GetSheHe] stands before the whole household and accuses me of having given myself to a daemon. [FromFrom.GetSheHe] asks about my dreams - and I do dream, of a beautiful voice in the dark, of a door that should not be opened.
Deny these ridiculous charges!
Tell [FromFrom.GetHerHim] of the dreams.
Make sure the [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] never speaks again.
Your [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] will hear of your dreams

My [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] has examined [From.GetFirstName], and comes to me white-faced. The child is marked by the Dark Gods, [FromFrom.GetSheHe] says, and it is the mother who let them in. Who knows what she did on the nights I was away?
I will hear no such slander!
Seize the witch! The child is no child of mine.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] denies everything, with tears and with fury. I cannot prove what I saw in the nursery. Not yet.
I will keep an eye on mother and child...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has told me of her dreams: a voice in the dark that promised her everything, a door she opened, a warmth that was not her husband's. There is no doubt left. The child is the spawn of a daemon, and its mother gave herself to the Ruinous Powers, knowingly or not.
She must abdicate, and the child must be disowned!
[From.GetFirstName] will be denounced publicly
These are only dreams and nightmares.
[From.GetFirstName] will be reassured
My [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] has heard my dreams and says they are no more than the nightmares every new mother has. [From.GetSheHe] will pray for me and for the child.

My [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] has denounced me before the whole court as a witch who gave herself to a daemon and bore its spawn. The servants make signs against evil when I pass, and my vassals whisper. [FromFrom.GetSheHe] demands that I give up my titles, take vows and let the child be disowned.
I will abdicate and go into the temple.
Never! Throw this lying priest in the dungeon!
[From.GetTitledFirstName] will not hear a word against the mother of [From.GetHerHis] child. Very well. I have warned [From.GetHerHim].
May [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName] watch over this house.

On the morning I came of age I woke knowing what I am. The voice that has whispered to me since the cradle speaks clearly now, and I understand every word. I am stronger than other men, cleverer than other men, and nothing they call sin binds me any longer. The Dark Gods made me for a purpose, and it is time to begin.
Let my TRUE nature be revealed for all to see!
I will hide it well. For now.
What the Child Became

[From.GetFirstName] is grown, and there is no longer any doubt what [From.GetSheHe] is. The sly smile, the cold eyes, the way the dogs still slink away - and the whispers among the servants of a voice that speaks from [From.GetHerHis] chamber when [From.GetSheHe] is alone. The Dark Gods have [From.GetHerHim], and perhaps always did.
What have I brought into the world?
[From.GetSheHeCap] shall lead us to victory!

The house is asleep. I creep down the corridor on bare feet, past the snoring guard, to the room where [From.GetFirstName] sleeps. [From.GetSheHeCap] stands between me and what is mine. The voice tells me what to do with the pillow.
Sleep, sweet [From.GetFirstName]...
[From.GetFirstName] tries to smother you in your sleep

I wake in the dark with something pressing down on my face. I cannot breathe. Small hands hold the pillow down with a strength no child should have, and a voice that is not [From.GetFirstName]'s whispers to me as I struggle...

I wake in the dark with a pillow over my face and small hands pressing it down. I fight, I kick, I scream - and the guard comes running. [From.GetFirstName] is gone when the candle is lit, and back in [From.GetHerHis] own bed, sleeping like an angel, when they look.
It was [From.GetFirstName]! I know it was!
I wake in the dark with a pillow over my face and small hands pressing it down. I fight until the darkness takes me. When I wake again the world is strange and far away, and the words will not come.
Death in the Nursery

[From.GetFirstName] was found dead in bed this morning, the face blue, the pillow on the floor. The physicians speak of a fit in the night. The servants speak of other things, and look at [From.GetFirstName]'s sibling, who sat by the body all morning and smiled.
May [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName] receive this innocent soul.
The blessed child of the Dark Gods is playful...
Terror in the Nursery

[From.GetFirstName] woke screaming in the night, swearing that someone had tried to smother [From.GetHerHim] with a pillow - and that it was [From.GetHerHis] own sibling. The guard found no one. The child will not sleep alone again.
Nightmares. Surely just nightmares.
Horror in the Nursery

[From.GetFirstName] was found senseless in bed this morning, a pillow on the floor beside [From.GetHerHim]. The physicians say [From.GetSheHe] will live, but the mind is gone: [From.GetSheHe] stares at nothing and does not know us. Only when [From.GetHerHis] sibling comes into the room does [From.GetSheHe] begin to scream.
What horror has come into this house?

The physicians cannot explain it. Wounds that should have left me crippled for life have closed overnight, the flesh knitting smooth and whole, the bones straight. The voice in the dark laughs at their confusion.
I am whole again!
For months there was only darkness. Then, one morning, a grey light - and by evening I could see as well as ever. The priests call it a miracle. It is not their god I have to thank.
I can see!
What the knife took has grown back. The physicians make signs against evil, the priests will not meet my eye, and I laugh.
Nothing can be taken from me.
The fog in my head has lifted. For a long time I was lost somewhere far away, but the voice found me and led me back, and now my mind is sharper than ever.
I have returned.
The pestilence that kills everyone around me has passed me over. The fever broke in a single night and the sores are gone. The voice says I have work still to do.
Death has no claim on me.
When the jailer came this morning the door of my cell stood open and the guards slept like the dead. No one saw me leave. No one remembers a thing.
Walls cannot hold me.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] is gone from the dungeon. The door was locked, the guards swear they never slept, and yet the cell is empty but for a smell of burning and a scratched sign on the wall that no one dares to look at.
Find [From.GetHerHim]!

Three riders came to my camp at dusk, women in black with eyes like coals, each with an army at her back. They bowed low and named me their [Root.GetMasterMistress], the chosen of the Dark Gods. Their soldiers are mine to command, and so are they.
Welcome, sisters.

A young woman has come to court asking for a place as nursemaid to [From.GetFirstName]. She is learned, well spoken and comes with the best letters, though no one can say who wrote them. The child, who screams at every other nurse, went to her at once and would not let her go.
Very well, she may stay.

A young woman has come to my court, asking for a place in my household. She is learned and well spoken, and when she looks at me I know at once that she knows what I am, and that she has come to serve.
Welcome, sister.
[From.GetFirstName], the nursemaid, has left my court to follow her charge. She would not stay a day without the child.
Odd woman.
The Nursemaid Falls

At the height of the feast the nursemaid climbed to the top of the tower, called out in a clear voice that she did it all for the child, and threw herself down. The guests have gone home in silence. No one can look at the child.
What did she mean, all for the child?
She has made her sacrifice.
The Nursemaid's Sacrifice
My nursemaid climbed to the top of the tower tonight, cried out that she gave herself for me, and leapt. The guests stare at me in horror. I feel a warmth, as if something has been paid.
The Chosen of the Dark Gods

The day of reckoning is nigh. The chosen of the Dark Gods, [From.GetTitledName], has come of age and stands revealed to the faithful! Our new [From.GetMasterMistress] will lead us to victory over the false gods and their weak servants. The brothers and sisters of the cult rejoice in the dark.
Hail the Dark Gods!
The djinn of the Dark Gods have heard us!
My [From.GetSonDaughter]! I am so proud...
The Chosen Falls
Our [From.GetMasterMistress], the chosen of the Dark Gods, is dead! The brethren are in shock, but we must not lose faith. The Ruinous Powers are patient, and what they made once they can make again.
The will of the Dark Gods be done!
